title: Normalized affine pullback models from an isomorphic source chart
statement: Let $A,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be affine and let $s:T\to A$ be an isomorphism. Let $M,N$ be quasi-coherent structure-sheaf modules on $A$ [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $P=\Gamma(T,s^*M)$ and $Q=\Gamma(T,s^*N)$ with their actual $\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$-module structures [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. There exist bijections $\delta_M:P\simeq\Gamma(A,M)$ and $\delta_N:Q\simeq\Gamma(A,N)$, chosen independently of the following data. For every affine scheme $W$, morphism $q:W\to A$, commutative ring $S$, ring homomorphism $r:\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)\to S$, and ring isomorphism $\rho:S\simeq\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$ satisfying $\rho(r(s^\sharp(b)))=q^\sharp(b)$ for all $b\in\Gamma(A,\mathcal O_A)$, there are additive equivalences $e_M:S\otimes_r P\simeq\Gamma(W,q^*M)$ and $e_N:S\otimes_r Q\simeq\Gamma(W,q^*N)$, semilinear along $\rho$, sending $1\otimes m$ to the pullback unit applied to $\delta(m)$. No finite presentation is assumed. No Hom comparison is asserted.

proof.text: The pullback unit for the isomorphism s is bijective on top sections. Fix δM,δN to be its inverse. Under s.appTop this inverse is semilinear; the choice uses only s,M,N. This follows also by restricting along the open immersion s, whose range is all of A.

Use the affine spectrum charts of A,T,W, the ring presentation ρ and affine quasi-coherent reconstruction. The ring equation identifies q with the ring map r after the starting isomorphism s. The tensor-pullback comparison gives eM,eN; on b tensor m its value is ρ(b) times the pullback of δ(m). This proves both semilinearity and the unit formula. Inverse affine reconstruction gives the inverse maps, including for zero rings.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_isomorphic_source_normalized_models
    {A T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine A] (s : T ⟶ A) [IsIso s]
    (M N : A.Modules) (hMq : M.IsQuasicoherent) (hNq : N.IsQuasicoherent) :
    let P := ModuleCat.of Γ(T, ⊤) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback s).obj M, ⊤)
    let Q := ModuleCat.of Γ(T, ⊤) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback s).obj N, ⊤)
    ∃ (δM : (P : Type u) ≃ Γ(M, ⊤)) (δN : (Q : Type u) ≃ Γ(N, ⊤)),
      ∀ (W : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsAffine W) (q : W ⟶ A)
        (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (r : Γ(T, ⊤) →+* S) (ρ : S ≃+* Γ(W, ⊤)),
        (∀ b, ρ (r (s.appTop b)) = q.appTop b) →
        ∃ (eM : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj P ≃+
            Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M, ⊤))
          (eN : (ModuleCat.extendScalars r).obj Q ≃+
            Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj N, ⊤)),
          (∀ b z, eM (b • z) = ρ b • eM z) ∧
          (∀ b z, eN (b • z) = ρ b • eN z) ∧
          (∀ m, eM ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[Γ(T, ⊤), r] m) = pullbackΓ q M (δM m)) ∧
          (∀ m, eN ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[Γ(T, ⊤), r] m) = pullbackΓ q N (δN m))
